title: Soft Vol daily closes
description: Append one object to points at each weekday cash close. One point per session, dates ascending, starting 2026-10-30. Soft Vol is the VIX close minus HV20 of the S&P 500, rounded to 0.1. This file does not continue the weekly Desk blend. It does not take an underlying-vol change input. Vol Stress stays a separate series.

cadence.description: One point per session, taken after the official cash close.

seriesBreakLabel.const: series break, new definition from 2026-11-02 lock

band.description: Soft Vol at or below −0.4, Stretched at or above +0.4, Fair in between. Applied to the raw residual.

points.description: Append one close per session. Do not rewrite an earlier session.

hv20.description: 20-day realized vol of SPX, sample stdev of 20 log returns, times √252, times 100, rounded to 0.01.

spx.description: SPX close for the same session. The last of the 21 closes used for HV20.

softVol.description: VIX close minus HV20, rounded to 0.1.

origin.description: seed: the 2026-10-30 reconstructable print. close-routine: appended after the official cash close.

recordedAt.description: When the close routine wrote the point, with a UTC offset. Required for close-routine points.

latest.title: Soft Vol latest close
latest.description: The newest daily print. Rewritten when a session is appended. Same formula as the series. No underlying-vol change field.
